description: Open source inference engine for agents that optimizes itself for your exact hardware. Compiles and tunes its kernels on your device, so open models run up to 2x faster than llama.cpp. Works on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, or just a CPU.
summary: Open source local inference engine. It runs models on the hardware you already have, whether that's a Mac, an NVIDIA or AMD GPU, or just a CPU. Plug it into Pi, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex, Claude Code, Oh My Pi, and Cline.
